description: Institut Paris Region (L'Institut Paris Region, regional planning agency) publishes 33 layers of the SDRIF-E regulatory maps of the Île-de-France region (published July 2025 and January 2026) covering, among others, airport sites and platforms, river development, transport projects for public transport and road, multimodal sites and facilities, crossings of linear infrastructure and polarities made of one or several communes, plus older layers of the previous plan for transport projects and existing public transport. Coverage: the Île-de-France region; layers were last modified between July 2025 and January 2026. Format and access: CSV, shapefile, GeoJSON and KML downloads plus ArcGIS REST feature services, without registration from the Institut Paris Region open data hub. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Licence ouverte (Etalab Open Licence); cost: free. Caveats: the portal says the regulatory-map data are intended for use at 1:150,000 and cannot replace the paper map, so they are not parcel-level; the layers are planning intentions, not built assets; the counts of features were not read. Simulation uses: planned-transport and infrastructure inputs for regional network and land-use scenarios, exposure planning, and checks of planned corridors against flood and hazard layers. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
